articles.title: Amazon’s new Kindle Colorsoft is a premium e-reader with a premium price
articles.author: Aisha Malik
articles.content: The latest model is lighter and thinner than its predecessor and features an edge-to-edge display. But if you already own the first-generation Colorsoft, there’s little reason to upgrade.

articles.title: Jensen Huang’s departure blasts big hole in AI startup funding, VCs and founders say
articles.author: Marina Temkin, Dominic-Madori Davis
articles.content: Nvidia poured tens of billions into AI startups under Huang. Without him at the helm, founders and VCs are bracing for smaller checks and lower valuations.

articles.title: This young startup wants to power floating data centers with the ocean’s heat, and investors are already on board
articles.author: Tim De Chant
articles.content: Drogue is harvesting heat from the ocean to power data centers on floating vessels. The first prototype should be bobbing around the ocean, crunching bits, in less than two years.
